avoid: Complex canoe spatial formations without supervision
children.game_version: A call-and-response rhythm game following the fa'aluma commands ('tulolo' and 'nofo').

seniors.seated_version: Performed from a stable chair maintaining the seated upper-body claps and gestures.
seniors.standing_version: Omit standing sections if mobility requires remaining seated.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Modify arm extension range and reduce striking force to protect joints.

feedback_rules.description: Compare timing of hand slaps to group unison; note that individual gesture variations exist as modern moves are added.

learning_units.description: Execute seated response to fa'aluma commands tulolo and nofo.

prerequisites.description: Ability to sit in rows and perform upper body percussive strikes.

social_formats.description: Large group formation, traditionally whole villages sitting in rows.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Precise, rhythmic claps and intricate hand movements depicting everyday practices, fish, birds, cooking, cleaning, and paddling.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Large group of people, traditionally whole villages, moving into formations like a large canoe with arms mimicking paddles.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Seated and standing levels; jumps not described in sources.
movement_profile.posture: Usually seated, with parts of the dance requiring the group to stand up.

signature_moves.description: Arms on the outside mimic the movement of paddles in the water while the group forms a large canoe.
signature_moves.name: Canoe paddling

music_profile.vocal_style: Chants like 'Talofa' at the beginning and 'Tofa' at the end, directed by the fa'aluma yelling 'tulolo' and 'nofo'.

basic_steps: Execute rhythmic claps and hand movements
Mimic everyday actions like cooking, paddling, or cleaning while seated
Stand up for designated standing sections
teaching.formation: Large group, normally seated in rows
teaching.level_notes: Performed by all ages and genders; movements range from traditional gestures to newly added contemporary moves.
